objective: Adversarially attack the S01 ESCAPE-RANK side gate by constructing exact complete-star release cycles and arbitrarily deep separator-local periodicity, then isolate the weakest history-aware premise that survives without promoting it to terminal reducibility.

atomic_claims.text: In the exact C37-derived alternating high-port strip, every interior 010/101 degree-four wheel has a two-two boundary colouring that extends to every same-boundary strictly smaller simple oriented replacement but not to the original wheel.

If complete-star release states remember only the current active wheel, the exact C37-derived alternating strip has raw two-cycles W_i to W_{i+1} to W_i; hence no well-founded rank can strictly decrease on every unnormalized release transition.

Even alternating oriented bipyramids give a root-class cyclic stress test in which every rim wheel is obstructed and a locally canonical successor-release rule cycles around the rim; this is not claimed to be a C37 descendant.

A repeated directed octahedral shell can be spliced to arbitrary depth into the directed face (7,z_n,13) of an exact C37-derived high-port strip while preserving the old rotation and minimum semidegree, producing locally identical genuine separating triangles and defeating purely local separator ranks.

The present families do not refute a normalized history-aware lexicographic rank on unseen vertices, incomplete exposed stars, and unprocessed rooted separator sides; such a rank proves source-discovery well-foundedness only, not terminal reducibility or GSRC/JMAP.

assumptions: All source graphs are finite simple plane orientations and every displayed rotation/face/star belongs to the frozen construction.
Cycle-1 S02-B C37 edge-split geometry is used only above d(7)=6; the merged 160-row C37 table is not extrapolated.
A same-boundary strict replacement retains all four distinct boundary ports; the one-internal-vertex wheel therefore has no internal vertex after a strict same-boundary replacement.
The raw release-cycle falsifier applies only to a transition system that allows source-valid boundary-star release without monotone no-backtracking history.
The bipyramid is a root-class stress test rather than an asserted GSRC/JMAP source child.
The nested shell statement is an explicit octahedral construction and is not identified with the unbound AE/M12/S14 cap claim.
risks: The actual S02-A transition system has not yet been repository-bound, so the two-cycle refutes the natural raw release relation rather than every possible normalized transition definition.
A history-aware exposure rank can terminate only by exposing the finite source graph and may be useless for proving a local reduction theorem.
The generic bipyramid may be excluded by future LSRC/GSRC source-generation hypotheses.
Nested separator stacks remain inside a fixed outer triangle and therefore do not refute global fixed-interface profile compression.
No separating-triangle composition theorem, GSRC, JMAP, L_join, B-criticality, EvidenceLink or Result is supplied.

failed_route_proposal.blocker: Any history-free escape rank required to strictly decrease on every source-valid complete-star release or unrooted separator-crossing transition fails: the exact alternating strip contains raw release two-cycles, and local separator geometry can repeat to arbitrary depth.
